crosswalk.name: Navigator origin and workflow definition
crosswalk.navigator: Navigator Workflow Definition ID, execution context and sending step
crosswalk.registry: Retain reference provenance; no entry exists by virtue of workflow initiation

crosswalk.name: Receiving role and action class
crosswalk.navigator: Receiving institution Registry and requested action distinguish review from creation
crosswalk.registry: Explicit receiver intake/denial contract and permissions, not implied by documentation
crosswalk.decision: Registry D-2A-02 receiving scope, accepting or refusing read-only handoffs

crosswalk.name: Source attribution and version
crosswalk.navigator: Complete input references, provenance, source version-at-use, unresolved status
crosswalk.registry: Authoritative source institution + canonical source record + ID + historical version, no invented ownership
crosswalk.decision: Certifier D-2A-01 if source is Certification Package

crosswalk.name: Registrability boundary
crosswalk.navigator: May request review, not decide registrable
crosswalk.registry: Independent Source Authority, scope, approved Record Type, durable relevance and registrability determination
crosswalk.decision: Registry registrability policy and review/denial semantics

crosswalk.name: SREG creation
crosswalk.navigator: Handoff does not allocate or assign SREG
crosswalk.registry: Only Registry owner can create distinct SREG and Registry ID after governance
crosswalk.decision: Separate Registry action approval; not included in read-only plan

crosswalk.name: Validation and publication
crosswalk.navigator: Never interpret validation or workflow progress as publication
crosswalk.registry: Post-construction validation, distinct lifecycle activation and publication decisions
crosswalk.decision: Registry rules, effective controlled values and owner-approved action

crosswalk.name: Response, unknown and refusal
crosswalk.navigator: Track workflow-local hold, rejection, timeout, unavailable without converting to institutional failure
crosswalk.registry: Potential typed receiver response must be owner-defined; no invented machine enums
crosswalk.decision: Owner approval of exact denial, no-result and not-processed meanings

crosswalk.name: Idempotency, trace and audit
crosswalk.navigator: Attempt identity, trace context and fixed input reference/version
crosswalk.registry: Durable receiving event, replay policy, authenticated acting role and resulting object readback only if authorized

crosswalk.name: Relationship and authority
crosswalk.registry: Registry native registers SREG→source only after Registry-governed creation; no inferred Suite references
crosswalk.decision: D-2A-04 independently governs any predicate bridging

crosswalk.name: Historical/current source checks
crosswalk.navigator: Retain observation date and source state-at-use separately from currentness
crosswalk.registry: Historical or unavailable sources may remain reviewable with owner decisions; do not infer current state
crosswalk.decision: D-2A-06 historical/current source and human/machine parity proof
